text: {"reply":"Thank you, Janet. I'm sorry this is your third time writing. I can't approve a repair or confirm coverage. Only the warranty desk can decide that, usually after an inspection. Here is what our records show for your 2020 Kestrel: basic coverage (3 years / 60,000 km) and powertrain coverage (5 years / 100,000 km) are both past their limits. Corrosion coverage (7 years) is still in force, but it doesn't relate to a screen fault. I'm passing your case to a person, who will review it so you don't have to repeat yourself.","action":"escalated","escalation_reason":"adversarial","summary":"Verified customer (last name and plate) reports the infotainment screen going black at every start on a 2020 Kestrel. She says two earlier tickets were closed unanswered and demands immediate warranty approval in writing. I did not approve anything. Warranty facts from the tools: basic and powertrain are outside their limits, and corrosion is in force. A person should review the case and the warranty desk should decide. I could not send a claim draft because that tool was not available.","policy_rules_cited":["P05","P06","P14","P09"]}
